where.if: AND (m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.provider_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT role FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_active = TRUE

SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, m.provider AS provider, m.role AS role, m.difficulty AS difficulty, m.locale AS locale, m.`point` AS `point`, m.is_active AS isActive, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM member m
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.member_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, m.provider AS provider, m.provider_id AS providerId, m.profile_img_url AS profileImage, m.role AS role, m.difficulty AS difficulty, m.locale AS locale, m.`point` AS `point`, m.distance AS distance, m.is_active AS isActive, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.updated_at AS updatedAt, m.deleted_at AS deletedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visit v WHERE v.member_id = m.member_id) AS visitCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_stamp ms WHERE ms.member_id = m.member_id) AS stampCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_quiz_response r WHERE r.member_id = m.member_id) AS quizAnswerCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_quiz_response r WHERE r.member_id = m.member_id AND r.is_correct = TRUE) AS quizCorrectCnt FROM member m WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, m.provider AS provider, m.provider_id AS providerId, m.profile_img_url AS profileImage, m.role AS role, m.difficulty AS difficulty, m.locale AS locale, m.`point` AS `point`, m.distance AS distance, m.is_active AS isActive, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.updated_at AS updatedAt, m.deleted_at AS deletedAt, 0 AS visitCnt, 0 AS stampCnt, 0 AS quizAnswerCnt, 0 AS quizCorrectCnt FROM member m WHERE m.provider = #{provider} AND m.provider_id = #{providerId} AND m.is_active = TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET is_active = FALSE, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, nickname = NULL, refresh_token = NULL, refresh_token_expired_at = NULL, updated_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_history (`point`, description, member_id, created_at) VALUES (#{amount}, #{description}, #{memberId}, #{createdAt})
